title: 动词搭配与短语
goal: 结合语境理解短语并选择动词搭配。

points.label: 理解动词短语的整体含义
选择符合上下文及宾语的搭配

body.p: 动词和后面的词大多有固定的组合。短语的整体意思要结合宾语和情境来判断。

body.box: She got over the fence. / She got over her fear of water.

body.p: 第一句的 get over 是越过栅栏，第二句是克服恐惧。宾语不同，同一个短语的意思也不同。

cards.title: 词汇表：付出努力
rows: She made an effort to listen carefully.
He tried his best to finish the race.
They worked hard on the display.
She spared no effort to prepare the room.
I did my best to explain the route.
They put effort into the design.
He kept trying after the first attempt failed.
She took pains to check every name.

cards.title: 词汇表：作出决定
rows: She made up her mind to join the club.
They made a decision after talking.
The group reached a decision together.
He made a choice between two routes.
They decided on the blue cover.
She chose between tea and water.
The committee came to a decision.
They settled on Saturday for the visit.
He weighed the options before choosing.
She changed her mind and stayed home.

cards.title: 词汇表：提供帮助
rows: He lent a hand with the boxes.
She gave me a hand with the chairs.
He offered help when the bag tore.
The teacher provided support throughout the project.
They helped out at the event.
She gave advice on using the tool.
We shared the work of cleaning.
He looked after the plants while she was away.
They cared for the injured bird.
Her friends stood by her during the difficult period.

cards.title: 词汇表：克服困难
rows: He got over his fear of speaking.
They overcame a difficulty with the design.
She solved the problem by changing the route.
He dealt with the broken shelf first.
They worked through the problem together.
She coped with the delay calmly.
They found a way around the blocked road.
The team faced a challenge when the lights failed.
She carried on after a short rest.

items.stem: After considering both clubs, Nina decided firmly to join the music club. She made up her ___.
items.why: make up one's mind 表示下定决心。

items.stem: Omar helped carry the boxes. He lent a hand. What did he do?
options: He asked others to carry the boxes.
He carried the boxes all alone.
He lent the boxes to a friend.
items.why: helped carry the boxes 说明 lent a hand 是帮忙，即第三项。第四项只照字面理解了 lent。

items.stem: She practiced speaking until she no longer feared it. She got over her ___.
items.why: get over her fear 表示克服恐惧。

items.stem: The team made an effort to finish the display. What did the team do?
options: It worked to complete the display.
It decided to cancel the display.
It gave the display to another team.
items.why: made an effort 表示为完成展览付出努力。

items.stem: The group considered two dates and finally chose Saturday. It settled ___ Saturday.
items.why: settle on 表示最终选定。

items.stem: Ari looked after the plants while his sister was away. What did he do?
options: He chose new plants for her.
He looked for a route to her house.
He cared for the plants for her.
He stopped her from buying plants.

items.stem: The team discussed the options and reached a ___.
items.why: reach a decision 表示作出决定。

items.stem: Lin carried on after resting. What did she do after the rest?
options: She handed the work to a friend.
She decided to stop the work.

items.stem: The group put a lot of ___ into preparing the concert.
items.why: put effort into 表示为某事付出努力。

items.stem: Ava weighed the options before choosing. What did she do?
options: She checked how heavy each item was.
She chose without thinking it over.
items.why: before choosing 说明 weighed the options 是选择前比较各个选项，即第三项。第一项只照字面理解了 weigh。

items.stem: The teacher gave useful ___ on correcting the drawing.
items.why: give advice 表示提出建议。

items.stem: After the delay, the team found a way around the blocked path. What did it find?
options: A reason to block the path
A plan to close the route
A way to delay the team
items.why: a way around the blocked path 指绕过阻断处的办法。

groups.fill: Our group wanted to prepare a performance. We decided to ma{ke} an effort; everyone would t{ry} their best and wo{rk} hard. We would sp{are} no effort, even when practice felt difficult. After discussing the music, we ma{de} up our minds and began. We planned to re{ach} a decision about the order together. We ma{de} a choice after listening to both songs. When I needed help, a friend le{nt} a hand. We ga{ve} a hand with moving chairs and g{ot} over our nerves before performing.

items.stem: After considering both routes, Jana made up her mind to take the shorter one. What did she do?
items.why: made up her mind 表示她决定采用较短的路线。

items.stem: The students made an ___ to finish the display before the visitors arrived.
items.why: make an effort 表示付出努力。

items.stem: Bo helped move the table. He lent a hand. What does this mean?
options: He lent his table to someone.
items.why: helped move the table 说明 lent a hand 是帮忙，即第三项。第二项只照字面理解了 lent。

items.stem: After practice, Ella no longer feared speaking in class. She got over her ___.
items.why: get over her fear 表示克服恐惧。

items.stem: The group discussed the problem step by step and worked through it. What did the group do?
options: It gradually dealt with the problem.
It chose a problem for another group.
It caused the problem during discussion.
items.why: worked through 指逐步处理问题。

items.stem: After comparing two designs, the students decided ___ the simpler one.
items.why: decide on 表示决定选用某物。
